_why: Published index for the CPCP shape ecosystem. Source of truth is the LinkML schema; the artifacts are reified from it. Consumers verify source_sha256 against the schema they were given and artifact sha256 against the bytes they read. Generated by tooling/linkml/generate_shapes.py -- do not hand-edit.

schemas.why: The pod's Note, asserted once. Ruby projects it through vv-graph Storable, Python reads it at the MIND seam, and the browser surface reads it as JSON -- three hand-written assertions of one shape before this.
